scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,print-bridge -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --workspace @gustopos/api" "npm run dev --workspace @gustopos/web" "npm run dev --workspace @gustopos/print-bridge"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @gustopos/shared && npm run build --workspace @gustopos/api && npm run build --workspace @gustopos/web && npm run build --workspace @gustopos/print-bridge
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web,print-bridge -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run start --workspace @gustopos/api" "npm run preview --workspace @gustopos/web" "npm run start --workspace @gustopos/print-bridge"
